en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall stone obelisk‑type war memorial standing in an open landscape under a cloudy sky. The base has an inscription in Latvian and the shaft bears a relief with a crossed sword and shield or similar military symbols. Low flowers or shrubs surround the monument. The print and border style suggest an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century postcard.
